# Knowledge Network

> The author's personal website: a hand-maintained index of essays,
> interactive experiments, media servers, art, and data analysis —
> centred on space, time, perception, and scientific vision, often
> approached through contested questions.

Home: https://followorbounce.github.io/

## Sections

- Waves — Universal Waves (master index of every wave family in nature: mechanical, electromagnetic, matter, plasma, gravitational, chemical, biological, information, astronomical, plus the shared mathematics): https://followorbounce.github.io/universal-waves
  - Waves — sound, light, seismic motion, and matter waves: https://followorbounce.github.io/waves
  - Music Is Mathematics — string physics, harmonics, equal temperament, digital audio, radio, cosmic resonance, nine-tool audio lab: https://followorbounce.github.io/music-mathematics
- Aerospace — spaceflight history and engineering. Index: https://followorbounce.github.io/aerospace/
  - Waves — sound, light, seismic motion, and matter waves: https://followorbounce.github.io/waves
- Maya Basics — Maya calendrical systems. Index: https://followorbounce.github.io/Maya-Calendar/
- Machinery — heavy machinery explained through engineering, physics, and mathematics. Index: https://followorbounce.github.io/machinery/
- Radio & Electronics — Radio Communications (frequency, modulation, propagation, spacecraft links, spectrum management): https://followorbounce.github.io/radio-communications. Media Servers (generative art, real-time rendering, GLSL shaders, projection mapping, signal processing, TouchDesigner/Notch/openFrameworks ecosystem): https://followorbounce.github.io/mediaservers.
  - Media Servers II — a real compiled GLSL shader, 3D projection mapping, Gerstner ocean waves, Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion, curl-noise flow fields, and every Universal Waves family mapped to a real rendering technique: https://followorbounce.github.io/mediaservers-shaders
  Also experiments and observations (planned).
- Instruments — Password & Passphrase Generator (client-side only, Web Crypto API, BIP-39 wordlist, no network calls): https://followorbounce.github.io/password-generator
- Technology — Blockchain Infrastructure (distributed systems, consensus mechanisms, cryptography, smart contracts, DAOs, tokenization, neutral/non-speculative, with real crypto.subtle hashing and ECDSA sign/verify demos): https://followorbounce.github.io/blockchain-infrastructure
- Philosophy — nature of time, consciousness, reality and perception, free will, ethics (planned).
- Personal — notes, travel stories, ideas, books and references, useful tools, archive (planned).
